title: Longitudinal multi-omics depth

dimensions.label: Input contract
dimensions.description: Declared formats, expected schema and fail-closed input validation.

dimensions.label: Data integrity
dimensions.description: Full-input hashing, duplicate/missing/infinite-value checks and bounded previews.

dimensions.label: Deterministic execution
dimensions.description: Seeded local analysis with reproducible parameters and stable ordering.

dimensions.label: Resource safety
dimensions.description: Memory-aware admission, row/feature budgets and safe-mode downgrade before allocation.

dimensions.label: Failure isolation
dimensions.description: Crash-loop circuit breaking, redacted diagnostics and page-preserving fail-closed behavior.

dimensions.label: Provenance
dimensions.description: Module, workflow, input, parameter, environment and runtime provenance in every result manifest.

dimensions.label: Result integrity
dimensions.description: Complete non-truncated table bundle with per-table checksums and preview completeness flags.

dimensions.label: Specialist adapter
dimensions.description: Protected execution plans and honest detection for every declared third-party engine.

dimensions.label: Evidence gate
dimensions.description: Explicit validation requirements and a scientific boundary that blocks unsupported claims.

dimensions.label: Usability and export
dimensions.description: Runnable demo/template plus machine-readable JSON and ZIP/CSV export surfaces.

validation_gates: Engine versions, parameters and logs retained
boundary: Longitudinal inference must account for repeated measures and informative missingness.
score_scope: Software-owned module quality only; specialist installation and external scientific evidence are separate axes.
